picks.title: Full-Body, Hand & Facial Motion Capture From Any Video In Blender
picks.headline: Full-Body, Hand & Facial Motion Capture From Any Video In Blender
picks.excerpt: BlendCap, a new Blender add-on from Arcomade, tracks full-body, hand, and facial motion from a single recorded video and retargets the performance onto game rigs (Rigify, Auto-Rig Pro, Mixamo, CloudRig) locally, with no internet required. It brings markerless video-to-motion capture — an ML pose-estimation capability that once needed suits and studios — directly into the game-character animation pipeline.
picks.rationale: Markerless video-to-mocap running locally inside Blender puts a studio-grade animation step within reach of a solo game artist — directly changes how character animation gets made.

picks.title: Reddit is forcing Google AI into hallucinating The Duskbloods characters before FromSoftware's game is even out
picks.headline: Reddit is forcing Google AI into hallucinating The Duskbloods characters before FromSoftware's game is even out
picks.excerpt: Fans have spent months inventing fake lore and bosses for FromSoftware's unreleased The Duskbloods on Reddit, and Google's AI Overviews are now surfacing those fabrications as fact. It's a vivid example of generative AI confidently hallucinating game content from unreliable community sources — a growing headache for studios trying to control the narrative and information around unreleased titles.
picks.rationale: A concrete case of AI Overviews laundering fan fiction into 'fact' about an unreleased title shows how generative search reshapes the information a studio can control around its own game.

picks.title: Good games will get cloned and buried: AI vibe coding is one of the biggest threats on storefronts like Steam, analyst warns
picks.headline: Good games will get cloned and buried: AI vibe coding is one of the biggest threats on storefronts like Steam, analyst warns
picks.excerpt: An industry analyst warns that AI 'vibe coding' is one of the biggest threats on storefronts like Steam, cautioning that well-made games risk being cloned and buried under a flood of quickly AI-generated titles. A look at how low-friction, prompt-driven game-making is reshaping the economics and discoverability of the market.
picks.rationale: An analyst framing vibe coding as a cloning-and-burying threat to storefront discoverability names the economic risk that fast AI game-making poses to the developers making original work.
